name: ds2.get_name
purpose: Confirm the live name for the remote-scan state DSID.
control_flow_proof: A005D93E searches all typed registries with bounded lookup; unknown ID yieldsNULL.

name: ds2.get_num_elem
purpose: Confirm no live array element count for the statically scalar scan-state ID.
control_flow_proof: A005D220 returns0 for registered scalar or unknown ID; interpret with get_name and static descriptor.

name: ds2.get_elem_size
purpose: Confirm no live record byte length for the statically scalar scan-state ID.
control_flow_proof: A005D274 returns0 for non-record IDs; interpret with get_name and static scalar descriptor.

name: ds2.get
purpose: Read existing remote-scan state without requesting a scan.
control_flow_proof: A005CA4A checks scalar-registry lookup A005C788 before data-store vtable+8. Missing/non-scalar returns0, so name/type checks are required.
hardware_access: Data-store scalar read callback; no scan event.

name: jm_urf.get_perf_timers
purpose: Capture four existing performance counters, then clear those volatile counters.
control_flow_proof: A024051A loads four words from RAM0x20A44774, formats total job/decompression/refill/I/O times, writes output. A024054E..A0240556 then stores four zero words to the same16-byte RAM block. No persistent storage, network, firmware update, scan, or motor calls.

side_effect.clear_occurs: After UART payload emission inside handler

capture_requirement: Keep exact first response as evidence of the pre-clear values. Do not retry after a valid prompt-returned capture merely to repeat output.
authorization_basis: User requested complete real command testing; parent explicitly authorized this low-impact read-and-clear operation.
